query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM crm_contacts ct
                        LEFT JOIN crm_companies co ON co.id = ct.company_id
                        JOIN team_user tu ON tu.team_id = ct.team_id AND tu.user_id = $1
                        WHERE ct.id = $2
                          AND (NOT (ct.hidden OR co.hidden IS TRUE) OR tu.team_role <> 'member')
                    ) AS "visible!"
